subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this sidebar-first iPhone navigation model, including removal of the tab bar and the persisted `Sidebar Agents` appearance preference?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the app’s primary navigation and user-visible defaults; correctness evidence cannot determine whether that product direction should ship.

options.title: Accept the sidebar shell
options.body: Approve the single sidebar navigation model once the failing localization gate and remaining platform checks pass.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Keep the session/dashboard improvements but retain or restore a tab-based primary-navigation contract.

options.title: Pause for design review
options.body: Defer merge until the iPhone navigation and preference behavior are explicitly reviewed against the native-app roadmap.

recommendation.title: Accept the sidebar shell
recommendation.body: Approve the single sidebar navigation model once the failing localization gate and remaining platform checks pass.
